tiers.A: In-frame camera work on the same picture (free, always available, uncapped but subject to motion variety rules)
tiers.B: Overlay on the picture: house graphic families, annotations, text emphasis
tiers.C: Full-frame plate that REPLACES the still for its duration (distinct shot: ends the still run)
tiers.D: Cutaway to other material (distinct shot: ends the still run)
tiers.S: Support only (audio). Never counts as an enrichment event on its own.

event_rule: An enrichment event is a change the viewer can SEE and that the narration motivates, anchored to a spoken word. Tiers A and B are events inside a still run. Tiers C and D end the run instead. Tier S never counts.

detail_crop.label: Detail crop / re-frame to a new part of the image
cues: a named object
a face in a crowd
a line of text in a document
'look at', 'notice', 'there, in the corner'

reveal.label: Reveal: open on a detail, pull out to the whole
cues: 'it turned out', 'what nobody saw', surprise or scale of a scene

punch_in.label: Punch-in on the key word
cues: pivot word in a tense or joyful beat

rack_focus.label: Focus pull onto the subject
cues: a person named for the first time
a quiet realisation

parallax_25d.label: 2.5D parallax (opt-in)
cues: establishing place or portrait that deserves depth

photo_annotation.label: Ellipse draw-on plus label on a detail
cues: pointing at a person, object, sign or caption inside the picture

spotlight.label: Dim the rest, light the target
cues: one face in a group photo
one item in clutter

keyword_pop.label: One pivot word pops beside the subject
cues: the single word the beat turns on ('NO.', 'DECLINED')

kinetic_quote.label: Spoken quote, word by word, emphasis in gold
cues: short quotation (<= 25 words) read aloud

stat_counter.label: Count-up number with label
cues: a number is the beat ('5,000 boys', '$4,000,000')

location_stamp.label: Typed place and date
cues: new place or time jump

date_strip.label: Date pill / timeline bar
cues: chronology jump over 2 years

person_pin.label: Ring + leader + name plate on a person in frame
cues: naming one person inside a group shot

lower_third.label: Name plate
cues: first appearance of a named person

group_legend.label: 'In this photo' names band
cues: group photo, names known but not positions

source_tag.label: Truth-tier chip + source
cues: quoted or reported claim

article_highlight.label: Marker sweep over the exact quote on a document image
cues: written evidence cited as proof

timeline_strip.label: 2-5 event band
cues: life-arc recap

story_tracker.label: Story hand-off chip row
cues: switching between subjects

map.label: Purposeful map (route, locator, distance)
cues: geography IS the beat: journey, distance, border, before/after
map.guard: A place that is merely mentioned does NOT get a map (Toolkit 2.3).

article_card.label: Full-frame article / document card
cues: headline or legal text is the beat

quote_card.label: Quote pull-out over dimmed plate
cues: long quotation (> 25 words)

then_now.label: Then / now role struck through
cues: 'where are they now' payoff

split_screen.label: Two images side by side
cues: before/after, claimed vs real

photo_stack.label: Archival photo stack
cues: rapid sequence of supporting proofs

stat_plate.label: Full-frame big number
cues: scale surprise

narration_plate.label: Key-fact plate built from the line itself on a texture plate (last-resort fallback that is always available)
cues: no second asset exists for a long beat
narration_plate.guard: Text must be verbatim narration or a verified fact; 2.5-3.5 s. Heavy use (> 2 per 10 min) means the research failed: asset_audit.py raises research requests; do not hide it.

broll_cutaway.label: Cutaway to related B-roll or ALT image
cues: any beat; first choice for a long hold

archival_insert.label: Archival footage insert (muted)
cues: event described has period footage

sfx_accent.label: SFX hit or whoosh
cues: supports a visual event; never replaces one

music_swell.label: Music swell or duck
cues: supports a visual event; never replaces one

map_overlay.label: Map drawn as a transparent overlay on footage or a still
cues: geography IS the beat but the picture should stay visible
map_overlay.guard: Shares the map cap (max 2 per 10 min across map + map_overlay).

stamp.label: Angled document stamp (CONFIRMED / ARCHIVED)
cues: critical document reveal

narration_to_method.cue: a place or journey that IS the story
a document or headline is cited
an object or detail in the picture
a list or run of proofs

fix_order_for_long_still: 1. Add a distinct asset (second picture or footage) on the words that change topic (broll_cutaway / archival_insert).
2. Replace part of the hold with a full-frame plate (map, article_card, quote_card, stat_plate, then_now, split_screen).
3. Only for 4.5-6.0 s: keep the one picture and add tier A/B events so no event-free gap exceeds the preset's enrich_gap_s.
4. Nothing available: narration_plate (always buildable). Never a black or empty slot, never a return to an earlier picture.
